title: ZPA software components: Manager software, OAuth enrollment, network settings and STIG images

prose.text: A question about App Connectors, Private Service Edges, Private Cloud Controllers or Network Connectors that is not specific to one of them splits by what the reader is trying to learn:

steps.label: What does the Manager do, and why did an update fail?
steps.text: The Manager service, its child process, its upgrades and update troubleshooting: [[zpa.software-components.manager]].

steps.label: How does a component enroll with an OAuth token, and why did it not?
steps.text: Token and provisioning key precedence, the network needs and the enrollment failure list: [[zpa.software-components.oauth-enrollment]].

steps.label: What network settings can a group have?
steps.text: DNS, NTP, static routes, explicit proxy, TCP keepalive and split DNS zones: [[zpa.software-components.network-settings]].

steps.label: What are the password rules and the 2024 expiry issue of STIG images?
What are the ZPA appliance's models, ports and enrollment steps?
steps.text: Hardware, power, port mapping, installation troubleshooting and enrollment: [[zpa.software-components.appliance]].

prose.text: Each component has its own subjects: [[zpa.app-connectors]], [[zpa.private-service-edges]], [[zpa.private-service-edges.private-cloud-controller]] and [[zpa.vpn.network-connectors]]. The enrollment (CA) certificates they enroll with are in [[zpa.certificates]].
